name: Flow Cancel
description: Cancel a hostile surge of qi by sounding its flow backward through the soul.

name: Circuit Gauge
description: Gauge the qi circuit of a foe through the soul and find the point where it will stall.

name: Calm Circuit
description: Keep the user's qi circuit calm and closed so a hostile qi blow finds no flow to ride.

name: Flow Easing
description: Ease the qi flow of a strained ally by cancelling the jitter that rides along it.

name: Qi Abate
description: Abate a stream of hostile qi at its source by holding the cancelling quiet against it.

name: Circuit Absolve
description: Absolve the qi circuit of an ally of a hostile knot and let the flow run free.

name: Flow Stanch
description: Stanch the qi flow of a foe at the wrist so that a rising technique has no fuel.

name: Recoil Null
description: Cancel the recoil of a failed qi technique in an ally before it can wound their soul.

name: Qi Quiescence
description: Rest a quiescence on both the soul and the qi so that hostile force of either kind dies there.

name: Qi Rebuke
description: Rebuke a hostile qi strike by turning its flow through the soul and sending it back.

name: Spell Efface
description: Efface a hostile qi technique from the air in both its body and its soul layer at once.

name: Quietborne Qi
description: streams: Nullify Soul + Qi; fold the cancelling soul into the flow of qi so that every hostile technique of either kind is undone at once.

name: Flesh Null
description: Cancel a hostile soul force at the skin before it can sink into the body.

name: Frame Gauge
description: Gauge the frame of a foe through the soul and find where its force is held tight.

name: Still Frame
description: Hold the whole frame still and loose so that a blow finds nothing rigid to break.

name: Sinew Ease
description: Ease the knotted sinew of an ally by cancelling the tension the soul has locked there.

name: Frame Abate
description: Abate a heavy blow by letting the whole frame go quiet at the moment of impact.

name: Marrow Absolve
description: Absolve the marrow of an ally of poison and taint by laying a cancelling quiet through the bone.

name: Nerve Stanch
description: Stanch the nerve signals of a foe so that their limbs answer slowly and without force.

name: Tension Release
description: Release the held tension in the muscle of an ally until the body can recover.

name: Body Quiescence
description: Rest a quiescence on body and soul together so that hostile force of either kind finds no hold.

name: Bone Rebuke
description: Rebuke a hostile blow through the bone and return it with the soul's mirrored calm.

name: Shock Undone
description: Undo the shock that stunned an ally's soul loose from the body and settle it back within the short window.

name: Frame Efface
description: Efface all hostile force from a whole company by setting every frame in it quiet.

name: Quiet Body
description: streams: Nullify Soul + Body; set the cancelling soul through flesh and bone so that the body itself turns hostile force to nothing.
